config_text:
# Two virtual displays available from boot: one per tablet slot. Creating
# one later needs root, so it is cheaper to have them ready.
options evdi initial_device_count=2
xorg: PID1966 logs modeset(G1) card0 and modeset(G2) card3; current /proc/1966/fd unreadable without root. Exact module-reference ownership unconfirmed.
interpretation: Two disconnected EVDI cards account for two extra unknown/N/A DRM devices. Module reference count is not GPU device count. No causal blackout claim. No configuration or loaded-module change.
